request_summary: Make the CI drift step call `git diff --exit-code` explicitly as requested, keeping the porcelain check so untracked generated files are still caught.
rationale: C2: bounded one-way door: deploy:.github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, deploy:.github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, deploy:declared:deployment — reduced-pipeline floor for ≤3 files in one real package; pipeline reach: no pipeline seat may edit .github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, so a pipeline lane could never finish this change — it is routed to the root session that ran this triage (or to the operator for any edit the root session's own grants refuse) and the handling is inline; the class above still states the change's weight (1 edit-target files / 0 package(s) (root pseudo-package excluded, Q1 2026-08-21) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=brownfield)
entry_point: GitHub Actions step "Verify generated agent distributions are in sync"
done_oracle: The drift step runs `node scripts/build-agent-dist.js`, then `git diff --exit-code`, then the porcelain check for untracked files, so the literal requirement is visible in the file while untracked generated files are still caught.
no_single_gate_reason: A GitHub Actions step has no local runner; GitHub's parser decides its validity at push time. The commands it runs are the same regenerate-then-diff check already measured locally (two consecutive builds leave the tree unchanged).
